description: Conservative planning guardrails from the original sizing calculator sheet. Applied as floors via max(additive, guardrail) for normal planning profiles — not blind overrides.

notes.crm: CRM sizing includes a planning guardrail based on active CRM users to avoid underestimating record and activity volume.
notes.office: Office productivity sizing uses the largest user/mailbox/collaboration basis for planning guardrails.
notes.sso: Identity sizing uses a conservative active-user planning guardrail because sign-in, MFA, policy, and application access events can vary significantly.
notes.casb: CASB default sizing uses policy/alert event rates (~0.005 GB/user/day), not inline SWG session volume. Select Full inline SaaS profile only when all proxied SaaS traffic is forwarded.
notes.saas_audit_only: Audit-only tenant baseline. User activity and integrations are not included.
notes.office_audit_only: Audit-only productivity logging. Mail, file, and collaboration activity are not fully included.
notes.containers: The original sizing sheet treated container/platform logging as a high-level item. Scope sizes it more accurately from clusters, nodes, and containers.
notes.cloud_storage_full: Full storage access logs can be much larger than management audit logs because every GET/PUT/READ/WRITE-style event may generate activity.
notes.firewalls: Firewall ingest is driven by traffic volume, protected users, policy logging, and threat logs — not only device count.
